posts.text: This is unprecedented: 2026 is currently on track to become the only calendar year in at least 30 years with zero 80%+ NYSE downside-volume days. These are days when at least 80% of NYSE trading volume comes from declining stocks, signaling unusually broad-based selling pressure. By comparison, 2008 had 49 such days during the Financial Crisis, versus 33 during the 2022 bear market and just 9 last year. Meanwhile, the average since 1997 is 21 such trading days, with no calendar year ever recording fewer than 5. In other words, broad-based selling pressure has been almost nonexistent so far in 2026. The market is more resilient than ever.

posts.text: A hybrid PWR and HTGR nuclear plant will start construction this year in China. The plant will have two 1000 MW (Hualong One) reactors and one 660 MWe high-temperature gas-cooled reactor (HTGR). Article link in reply. The idea is to create and heat steam using the PWRs, and heat the steam further (to higher temperatures) using the high-temp HTGR. The higher temperature stem will increase the efficiency of electricity production. The high temp steam could also be used for various industrial processes that require higher steam temperatures than LWRs alone can produce.
